meta_notes.headline: arity_lifts = FALSE. M2: R8-R2 = -0.0527 (arity HURTS). M3: R8-R2 = +0.0360 (below the 0.06 bar). The Davenport-Schinzel decision-complexity budget (2 -> 6 -> 10 arcs) does NOT convert into trained accuracy -- doc 53 SS4 pre-registered this branch as a real result.
meta_notes.descriptive_not_promoted: At M3, R4 - R2 = +0.0754, which WOULD clear the 0.06 bar. The registered criterion is R8-R2 and it FAILED. Per the exp44 lesson, a variant is never promoted onto a criterion it was not registered against. Recorded as descriptive only.
meta_notes.non_monotonic: R4 > R8 at BOTH cells (M2 0.7713 vs 0.7387; M3 0.7367 vs 0.6973). More outcomes eventually HURT -- mirroring the K-lever, where K=2 was representationally available but not exploitable, and the VQC literature's report that deeper circuits reduce performance.
meta_notes.validity: All arms genuinely used their arity (R4: 4/4 outcomes; R8: 6-8), and outcome probabilities stayed 3-term (~2e-07) while class scores did not (1.3e-02, 3.3e-02). These are admissible results, not null instruments.
meta_notes.scope: One dataset, two cells, simulation, constructed categories. Classical comparator pre-registered as a tie (doc 53 SS4.1); no quantum reading is licensed and doc 52 SS1 already closed the advantage question.
